All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience.

As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. The rest of the words are extremely hard for you to remember and to spell. In the process of recalling words, you can make your brain sharper.
